'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Micah Wooten DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Micah Wooten]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title FEAR THIS!! Line 30 I've Lost Artoo! (V) struck (omitted). Line 45 Lateral Damage → [[Imperial Decree (V)]]; line 46 Lateral Damage kept. Line 54 Sense → [[You Cannot Hide Forever]] + [[Mobilization Points]] (two cards for 60). Four [[Control]]. Darth Sidious AI → second [[Darth Sidious]]. Visage → [[Visage Of The Emperor]].
